en.title: Smart Garage Door System
en.shortDescription: A smart garage door system that detects when a user approaches and automatically unlocks the door via an MQTT-based communication system.
challenges: Ensure the system can accurately detect the user approaching the garage door.
Establish reliable MQTT communication between the Linux server and the door system.
Ensure the door system correctly processes and responds to MQTT signals.
features: Hands-free automatic door unlocking using mobile device proximity detection.
Remote access and control via a mobile app (if applicable).

zh-Tw.title: 智慧鐵捲門系統
zh-Tw.shortDescription: 使用 MQTT 通訊，偵測使用者接近後自動解鎖車庫門的智慧門禁系統。
challenges: 提升接近偵測的準確度與穩定性。
建立 Linux server 與門禁裝置間可靠的 MQTT 通訊。
確保門禁端能正確解析並回應 MQTT 訊號。
features: 以手機接近偵測實現免動手自動解鎖。
透過 MQTT 協定進行安全且即時的訊息傳遞。
可由行動端進行遠端控制（視專案實作情況調整）。
